title: LLM Provider Integrations
summary: This module provides integrations for various Large Language Model (LLM) providers, including Anthropic, Groq, Hugging Face, Mistral AI, Ollama, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. It offers unified interfaces for chat models, LLMs, and utilities for message conversion, usage metadata, and tool binding.

nodes.label: Handle LLM Retry Sleep
nodes.title: LLM Retry Sleep Handler
nodes.description: Manages asynchronous and synchronous callbacks for LLM retries, logging errors and ensuring proper task management during sleep periods.
